ig_carousel_topic.topic: Why anyone claiming an 80% win rate is lying or selling something
ig_carousel_topic.slide1_text:
Someone just told you they hit 80% of their picks.
Run.
ig_carousel_topic.slide2_text:
Most bettors assume a great handicapper wins 70, 80, even 90 percent of the time.
Sportsbooks would be bankrupt if that were true.
ig_carousel_topic.slide3_text:
The honest number: 53 to 58 percent is elite.
The Vegas hold exists because the house wins roughly 52.4% of bets. Beat that consistently and you are already in rare company.
ig_carousel_topic.slide4_text:
At 80%, a 100-bet sample would net roughly +57 units at -110 odds.
No public service has sustained that. The longest verified public runs top out around 58-60% over 500+ bets.
ig_carousel_topic.slide5_text:
54.3% across 490 graded picks this season. +45.6u. That's what real edge looks like.
Anyone promising 80% is selling a screenshot, not a record.
ig_carousel_topic.caption: If someone's claiming 80% win rate, ask for the full log. 54% sustained over hundreds of bets beats any cherry-picked screenshot. Save this before you buy a tout.
